_note: 1.6.1 (Batch D, N6) campus phases: what the campus and its key people are busy with during a stretch of the year. Each phase is {"id", "from": "M5 W1 Mon", "to": "M5 W2 Fri", "line": "one line for <now>"}; every year, inclusive. The engine puts the active phase's line into <now>. The lines are new canon: they are written in the canon waves (Batch G) and applied only after the owner approves each one. Empty until then.
